spec.purpose: Compare seven exact QK schedules: current prepared scalar, two global-plan layouts, two register-plan fused layouts, and new shared plans in4/8-group windows. Wave groups concurrently prepare different K16 groups, hand off exact plans through bounded LDS, and retire each score in original K16 order. Original zero-C WMMA partials and ascending FP32 predictors remain identical across windows. Actual carry alignment is verified before accepting each plan; any rejection recomputes the original full dot. The new variants have no global plan pointer. Check all raw outputs, independent CPU dots, normal/audit parity, immutable inputs, metadata, guards, tails and equal accepted/fallback totals. All seven variants allocate the same2GiB maximum comparison arena, which must stay entirely untouched for current and local-plan variants. Timers include native predictors, plan construction, ordered validation and fallback. No product dispatcher or arithmetic contract change.

compiled_kernel_resources.scope: Read-only static ELF kernel declarations, not measured occupancy.

implementation: Two new single-kernel schedules process4/8 K16 groups per window. Different wave groups construct plans for different K16 groups concurrently; shared memory hands off those independent plans to one ordered carry owner per score. The4/8-group plan tables use8192/16384 bytes, alongside4096/8192 bytes of Q/K staging. Native zero-C WMMA instructions produce the same approximate group partials, and each score preserves its ascending FP32 predictor across all windows. Plan storage is reused for partial bits, predicted exponents and final exact plans with full CTA barriers between owners. Every plan checks its actual carry exponent before acceptance, and any rejection restarts the original complete dot. The original current control, both global-plan layouts and both fused register-plan layouts are present in the same executable. All plan variants must report identical accepted-plan and fallback totals. No approximate value supplies an accepted output bit, no new hardware bound is assumed, and product dispatch is unchanged.
correctness_scope: Host ASan/UBSan checks8192 generated sequences and131072 original carry boundaries, with seven exact, approximate, incorrect and invalid guesses per group; rejected outputs remain unchanged, and valid scalar-float plans match the independent packed-integer plans. Native generated and captured outputs are checked bit-for-bit against original canonical GPU scores, including masked scores, guards and unused tails, alongside independent wide CPU dot checks. Every captured attempt also checks plan controls, plan guards and unused storage, and separately reruns audited completion to check output parity. Audit counters report only the final attempt per variant/slab and measure accepted plans before any full-score fallback. The q8192 component repeats the first1023 captured rows and is not a new real-model prompt. Original operands, prepared metadata and input encodings remain immutable. Oracle/reference data do not compute or select candidate work.
timing_scope: One warmup and three completed measurements per slab, with seven-variant order rotated across slabs. Timers include native partials, all plan preparation, exact ordered completion and complete original fallback. The same Q/K preparation is added once to every arm. All variants allocate the same maximum plan arena,2GiB at q8192 batch128, but every byte must remain untouched in the current, fused-register and shared-plan variants; only the two global-plan layouts use it. Allocation, reset, transfers, audit counting and verification are outside clocks. Every captured attempt checks outputs, guards and unused storage; separate audited execution checks output parity and records accepted/fallback totals after the final attempt. This is an isolated QK component experiment, excluding probability/PV, model load, TTFT and generation.

decision.decision: Keep both shared-plan windows isolated. Native generated and captured results preserve every original score bit, every accepted-plan/fallback total and all memory guards, but q8192 complete4/8-window costs599.8987/599.6873ms exceed current prepared QK337.6773ms and fused-register4 control580.1473ms. Smaller LDS does not establish occupancy or a product improvement. Changing the plan handoff alone is insufficient; the next structural experiment should replace scalar product-plan construction with exact integer matrix products plus sparse original-product compensation, while preserving actual-carry checks and full fallback. The tested model control, all performance targets and release gates remain unchanged.
